title: Detection on the finite integral generator
statement: For prime l, finite E/Q_l, a scheme T and level n with finite quotient coefficient ring, and ANY module sheaf M over the intrinsic finite ring sheaf, precomposition by single(finiteQuotient), after exact forgetting of coefficients, is injective on Hom(single(evaluated regular coefficient),single(M)[2]). All maps are the concrete maps of [def-sp-tower-class-finite]. No projective-line structure, Chern data, finite generation of M, or invertibility on T is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), second equality and injective-module argument

proof.text: Use the mixed-universe Grothendieck theorem locally to obtain enough injectives for the finite module-sheaf category, and hence Ext groups in universe u+1. Keep the chosen derived-category models in the theorem unchanged.

The already proved finiteQuotient_hom_bijective gives the degree-zero generator bijection. For every injective finite module sheaf I, finiteInjective_sections_acyclic gives vanishing of positive right-derived terminal sections of its underlying abelian sheaf. The existing terminal-sections/sheaf-cohomology comparison identifies this with vanishing of Ext from the constant integral sheaf.
Apply restrictionClass_bijective to the exact forgetful functor, finiteQuotient, the degree-zero bijection and the preceding acyclicity. This gives an injective Ext comparison in degree two.

Mathlib Ext.homEquiv identifies Ext with the chosen single-to-shifted-single morphisms. Ext.comp_hom, Ext.mk₀_hom and Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom identify the comparison with precomposition by single(finiteQuotient) followed by mapSingleArrow. Apply its injectivity and transport back through homEquiv.

theorem finiteQuotient_detects_derived_arrows (T : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      (SemilinearSections.ring.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (SpTowerShriek.B l E T n))) :
    Function.Injective (fun a :
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n).obj (coefficient T (Arings l E T))) ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ ↦
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb T) 0).map (finiteQuotient l E T n) ≫
        mapSingleArrow (finiteForget l E T n) (2 : ℤ) a)
